name: SiegeAmmoType - Default (seed v1)
description: One kind of siege weapon ammunition; heavy and light variants are separate ammo types. Templates list the ammo they may fire.

steps.description: Name the ammo and pick what it does on impact.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown on the targeting page and in game, e.g. 'Heavy boulder' or 'Incendiary bolt'. Must be unique.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional; a line for players about when to use it.

fields.label: Effect
fields.description: Impact (boulder, kinetic bolt): full damage in a small core, then a steep drop, projectile damage. Explosion (bomb, explosive bolt): even fall-off to the edge, blast damage. Fire: no fall-off, sets players alight. Poison: the same poison for everyone in the radius.

steps.description: Damage to players and to structures. Both use the effect's fall-off and only reach what has line of sight to the impact.

fields.label: Player damage
fields.description: Damage at the centre of the impact (a player has 20 health). Armour and shields reduce it the vanilla way.

fields.label: Structure damage
fields.description: Damage to gates and siege weapons in gate HP (a gate has 500 HP by default). The weapon's gate and weapon multipliers apply on top.

fields.label: Blast radius (blocks)
fields.description: How far from the impact players and structures are hit, 0 to 64.

fields.label: Knockback
fields.description: Push strength, weaker towards the edge. A blast pushes away from the impact, a direct hit along the flight path. 0 = none.

fields.label: Armour piercing
fields.description: 0 to 1: the share of the armour and enchantment reduction this ammo ignores. 0 = armour counts fully.

steps.description: Fire area for fire bombs, poison level and duration for carcasses. Leave empty when the effect doesn't use them.

fields.label: Effect radius (blocks)
fields.description: Fire: the area of ground fire. Poison: the poisoned area. Empty = the blast radius.

fields.label: Effect duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long players burn or stay poisoned.

steps.description: How the projectile looks in flight and what a shot costs.

fields.label: Projectile block
fields.description: The block shown flying for trebuchet and catapult shots, e.g. STONE or TNT. Ballista bolts are arrows.

fields.label: Particle trail
fields.description: The particle left behind in flight, e.g. SMOKE or FLAME. Empty = none.
